method.tracking_xy_rmse: sqrt(sum((vx-cx)^2+(vy-cy)^2)/(2*N)); all environments, full duration including command transitions
method.window_metrics: env 0 only; 40 <= simulation seconds < 120 for standing, first second of each six-second motion segment excluded
method.displacement: Euclidean world-xy end-to-start displacement; path is sum of consecutive xy distances; only interpreted without resets
method.heading: unwrapped yaw from wxyz root quaternion; distinct from body yaw rate
method.linear_fit_speed: norm of least-squares world-x/y slopes vs simulation time

limitations: One seed (42); no confidence intervals or universal acceptance claim.
Different training inputs and curriculum were changed together; their individual causal effects are not isolated.
Native student inference only; no held-out velocity-estimator error or paired teacher comparison in this batch.
No user-approved convergence criteria. No hardware validation.
